propositions: A single criterion's evidence run hitting its budget limit causes the entire recovery to fail, rather than preserving partial evidence and marking that criterion unverifiable
The per-criterion evidence loop in _recover treats budget exhaustion as fatal to the aggregate recovery when it should be a per-criterion safeguard

When any evidence run raises LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, or token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError, recovery should substitute a content-free placeholder entry and continue with remaining criteria
Recovery must only fail outright when EVERY criterion's evidence run fails, and should raise CompletionRecoveryError with diagnostic counts in that case
The placeholder evidence entry must be explicitly marked as exhausted and contain no affirmative content, preventing the finalizer from scoring the criterion as met
